statusbar.themeTitleAuto: Following the system ({{label}}). Click to switch to {{next}}.

dialog.unexpectedError:
NyaMark encountered an unexpected error: {{message}}

If something stops working, save your documents and restart NyaMark.

imagePolicy.title: Choose where to save pasted images
imagePolicy.subtitle: Choose a rule. Screenshots you paste later are saved by this rule automatically.

unsavedImage.title: Save this document before inserting pasted images
unsavedImage.subtitle: Screenshots have no original file path. Save the document first, or embed the image as Base64.

fileConflict.title: File changed on disk
fileConflict.body: "{{fileName}}" was modified by another app. Do you want to reload it and discard your unsaved changes?

copyTarget.title: Copy images outside the document folder?
copyTarget.body: This document’s front matter asks for images to be copied to "{{directory}}", which is outside the document’s folder. Allow this, or use your attachment settings instead?

unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedChanges.body: Do you want to save the changes you made to "{{fileName}}"? Your changes will be lost if you don’t save them.

attachmentError.base64TooLarge: The image is {{size}} MB, which exceeds the {{limit}} MB limit for Base64 embedding. Save the document first, then copy the image into a folder.
attachmentError.documentTooLarge: Embedding this image would make the document larger than {{limit}} MB, and NyaMark could no longer open it. Save the document first, then copy the image into a folder.

documentError.notUtf8: "{{fileName}}" is not UTF-8 encoded and was not modified. Convert it to UTF-8, then open it again.
documentError.notUtf8Known: "{{fileName}}" uses the {{encoding}} encoding and was not modified. NyaMark edits UTF-8 files only. Convert it to UTF-8, then open it again.
documentError.forbidden: NyaMark doesn’t have permission to access "{{fileName}}".
documentError.readOnly: "{{fileName}}" is read-only and was not modified. Use Save As to save your changes to another file.
documentError.tooLarge: "{{fileName}}" is larger than {{limit}} MB, the largest file NyaMark can edit.

exportPdf.title: Export to PDF
exportPdf.subtitle: Export "{{fileName}}" to PDF with the settings below.

settingsReset.title: Settings were reset
settingsReset.body: NyaMark couldn’t read its settings file and is using the default settings. The original file was kept at "{{path}}".

updates.title: A new version of NyaMark is available
updates.subtitle: You have {{current}}. {{latest}} is now available.
updates.failed: Unable to install {{latest}}. Download it manually from the download page.
updates.installed: {{latest}} is installed and will take effect after NyaMark restarts.
updates.upToDate: You are running the latest version, {{version}}.
updates.checkFailed: Check your network connection and try again.
updates.feedMissing: The update server has not provided version information yet. Try again later.
updates.saveFirst: {{latest}} has been downloaded. NyaMark quits during installation, so save your documents before you click Install now.
updates.noReleaseNotes: No release notes were provided for this version.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust how the editor looks and behaves.
settings.confirmResetBody: This will restore appearance, auto-save, and attachment options to their defaults. This action cannot be undone.

use-path.label: Keep original path
use-path.description: Link to the image where it is, without copying it.

copy-same-folder.label: Document folder
copy-same-folder.description: Copy the image into the document’s folder.

copy-assets.label: ./assets
copy-assets.description: Copy the image into an assets folder next to the document.

copy-custom-folder.label: Custom folder
copy-custom-folder.description: Copy the image into the folder chosen below.

base64.label: Embed as Base64
base64.description: Embed the image in the document as Base64.
